sentences.en: JULIE: Hello?
sentences.zh: JULIE: 喂？

sentences.en: GREG: Oh, hello
sentences.zh: GREG: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: Is that Julie Davison?
sentences.zh: 是朱莉·戴维森吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: Yes
sentences.zh: JULIE: 是的。

sentences.en: GREG: This is Greg Preston from the Employment Agency
sentences.zh: GREG: 我是就业中介公司的格雷格·普雷斯顿。

sentences.en: We met last week when you came in to enquire about office work
sentences.zh: 上周你来咨询办公室工作时我们见过面。

sentences.en: JULIE: Oh, that's right
sentences.zh: JULIE: 哦，对，是有这么回事。

sentences.en: GREG: Now we've just had some details come in of a job which might interest you
sentences.zh: GREG: 现在我们刚收到一份职位信息，可能你会感兴趣。

sentences.en: JULIE: OK
sentences.zh: JULIE: 好的。

sentences.en: GREG: So this is a position for a receptionist - I believe you've done that sort of work before?
sentences.zh: GREG: 这是一个接待员职位——我记得你之前做过这类工作，对吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: Yes, I have, I worked in a sports centre for a couple of years before I got married and had the children
sentences.zh: JULIE: 是的，我做过。我在结婚生子前，在一家体育中心工作了几年。

sentences.en: GREG: Right
sentences.zh: GREG: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, this job's in Fordham, so not too far away for you, and it's at the medical centre there
sentences.zh: 这个职位在福德姆，离你家不算太远，地点是那里的医疗中心。

sentences.en: JULIE: OK
sentences.zh: JULIE: 好的。

sentences.en: So where exactly is that?
sentences.zh: 那具体位置在哪里呢？

sentences.en: GREG: It's quite near the station, on Chastons Road
sentences.zh: GREG: 就在车站附近，查斯通斯路上。

sentences.en: JULIE: Sorry?
sentences.zh: JULIE: 对不起，您能再说一遍吗？

sentences.en: GREG: Chastons Road - that's C-H-A-S-T-O-N-S
sentences.zh: GREG: 查斯通斯路——拼写是C-H-A-S-T-O-N-S。

sentences.en: JULIE: OK, thanks
sentences.zh: JULIE: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: So what would the work involve?
sentences.zh: 那么这份工作具体包括哪些内容呢？

sentences.en: Dealing with enquiries from patients?
sentences.zh: 比如处理病人的咨询？

sentences.en: GREG: Yes, and you'd also be involved in making appointments, whether face to face or on the phone
sentences.zh: GREG: 是的，此外你还需要负责安排预约，无论是面对面还是通过电话进行。

sentences.en: And rescheduling them if necessary
sentences.zh: 必要时还需重新调整预约时间。

sentences.en: JULIE: Fine, that shouldn't be problem
sentences.zh: JULIE: 好的，这应该不成问题。

sentences.en: GREG: And another of your duties would be keeping the centre's database up-to-date
sentences.zh: GREG: 另一项职责是及时更新医疗中心的数据库。

sentences.en: Then you might have other general administrative duties as well, but those would be the main ones
sentences.zh: 此外，你可能还要承担一些其他常规行政事务，但以上几项是主要工作内容。

sentences.en: JULIE: OK
sentences.zh: JULIE: 好的。

sentences.en: GREG: Now when the details came in, I immediately thought of you because one thing they do require is someone with experience, and you did mention your work at the sports centre when you came in to see us
sentences.zh: GREG: 收到这份职位详情后，我立刻想到了你，因为雇主明确要求应聘者具备相关经验，而你上次来我们这儿时，曾提到你在体育中心的工作经历。

sentences.en: JULIE: Yes, in fact I enjoyed that job
sentences.zh: JULIE: 是的，事实上我很喜欢那份工作。

sentences.en: Is there anything else they're looking for?
sentences.zh: 他们还有其他要求吗？

sentences.en: GREG: Well, they say it's quite a high-pressure environment, they're always very busy, and patients are often under stress, so they want someone who can cope with that and stay calm, and at the same time be confident when interacting with the public
sentences.zh: GREG: 他们提到工作环境压力较大，日常总是非常繁忙，病人也常常处于紧张状态，因此希望应聘者能从容应对这种压力、保持冷静，同时在与公众交流时充满自信。

sentences.en: JULIE: Well, after dealing with three children all under five, I reckon I can cope with that
sentences.zh: JULIE: 嗯，毕竟我每天要应付三个五岁以下的孩子，我觉得自己完全能胜任。

sentences.en: GREG: I'm sure you can
sentences.zh: GREG: 我相信你一定可以。

sentences.en: GREG: And then another thing they mention is that they're looking for someone with good IT skills
sentences.zh: GREG: 另外，他们还特别提到希望应聘者具备良好的信息技术（IT）技能。

sentences.en: JULIE: Not a problem
sentences.zh: JULIE: 没问题。

sentences.en: GREG: So you'd be interested in following this up?
sentences.zh: GREG: 那么你有兴趣继续跟进这个职位吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: Sure
sentences.zh: JULIE: 当然。

sentences.en: When would it start?
sentences.zh: 什么时候开始上班？

sentences.en: GREG: Well, they're looking for someone from the beginning of next month, but I should tell you that this isn't a permanent job. it's temporary, so the contract would be just to the end of September
sentences.zh: GREG: 他们希望新员工从下个月初开始入职；不过我要提前告诉你，这不是一份长期固定职位，而是临时岗位，合同期仅到九月底为止。

sentences.en: But they do say that there could be further opportunities after that
sentences.zh: 但他们也表示，之后可能会有进一步的聘用机会。

sentences.en: JULIE: OK
sentences.zh: JULIE: 好的。

sentences.en: And what would the hours be?
sentences.zh: 那么工作时间是几点呢？

sentences.en: GREG: Well, they want someone who can start at a quarter to eight in the morning - could you manage that?
sentences.zh: GREG: 嗯，他们希望应聘者早上七点四十五分开始上班——你能做到吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: Yes, my husband would have to get the kids up and off to my mother's - she's going to be looking after them while I'm at work
sentences.zh: JULIE: 可以，我丈夫得负责把孩子们叫醒并送他们去我母亲家——她会在我上班期间照看孩子们。

sentences.en: What time would I finish?
sentences.zh: 我几点下班？

sentences.en: GREG: One fifteen
sentences.zh: GREG: 下午一点十五分。

sentences.en: JULIE: That should work out all right. can pick the kids up on my way home, and then I'll have the afternoon with them
sentences.zh: JULIE: 这样安排应该没问题。我可以在回家路上顺道接孩子们，然后整个下午都能陪他们。

sentences.en: Oh, one thing ... is there parking available for
sentences.zh: 哦，还有一件事……中心有员工停车位吗？

sentences.en: staff at the centre?
sentences.zh: 工作人员在中心有停车位吗？

sentences.en: GREG: Yes, there is, and it's also on a bus route
sentences.zh: GREG: 有的，而且那里也通公交车。

sentences.en: JULIE: Right
sentences.zh: JULIE: 明白了。

sentences.en: Well, I expect I'll have the car but it's good to know that
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我会开车去，但知道有公交线路可选也很不错。

sentences.en: OK, so where do I go from here?
sentences.zh: 好的，那接下来我该怎么做？

sentences.en: GREG: Well, if you're happy for me to do so, I'll forward your CV and references, and then the best thing would probably be for you to phone them so they can arrange for an interview
sentences.zh: GREG: 嗯，如果你同意的话，我就把你的简历和推荐信转给他们；然后你最好直接打电话联系他们，以便他们安排面试。

sentences.en: JULIE: Great
sentences.zh: JULIE: 太好了。

sentences.en: Well thank you very much
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您！

sentences.en: GREG: You're welcome
sentences.zh: GREG: 不客气。

sentences.en: Bye now
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: JULIE: Bye
sentences.zh: JULIE: 再见。
